title: Oracle price
description: The BTC price this oracle is reporting, on its own schedule. Freshness says whether the latest value is recent enough to trust.

value.label: Oracle price
value.description: The oracle's latest published BTC price, in dollars. Oracles update less often than exchanges, so it can lag spot by seconds.

freshness.label: Oracle freshness
freshness.description: Fresh when the latest value is inside the oracle's normal update interval, stale when it has gone quiet. Stale oracles should not be traded on.
